# List of awards and nominations received by Becky G

}}
American singer and actress Becky G has received many awards and nominations throughout her career. Gomez has received several industry honors, including the Impact Award (2023) at the Billboard Women in Music, and Global Impact Award (2026) at the Billboard Latin Women in Music. She was named to Forbes 30 Under 30 (2023) and Time 100 (2025). Gomez was honored by the Inspira Award from the Hispanic Heritage Foundation in 2015, and received The Latin Recording Academy as one of the Leading Ladies of Entertainment in 2018.
Throughout the late 2010s, she released a number of singles and collaborations, earning further nominations at the Billboard Latin Music, Latin American Music, Lo Nuestro, and Premios Juventud awards ceremonies. Her collaboration with Bad Bunny on the single "Mayores", which received nomination for Billboard Music Award for Top Latin Song. In 2019, Gomez released her debut studio album, Mala Santa, and received the Extraordinary Evolution Award at Latin American Music Awards.
Her collaboration with Christina Aguilera alongside Nicki Nicole and Nathy Peluso on the single "Pa Mis Muchachas", garnered three nominations at the 23rd Annual Latin Grammy Awards, including for her work on the album as a featured artist on the track, Gomez was nominated for Latin Grammy Award for Album of the Year. Her collaboration with Karol G on the single "Mamiii" earned four Billboard Latin Music Awards nominations and winning two accolades at the Latin American Music. The track also earned the nomination for Latin Grammy Award for Best Urban Song. Her collaboration with Ángela Aguilar and Leonardo Aguilar on the song "Por el Contrario" earned the nomination for Latin Grammy Award for Best Regional Mexican Song.
